History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has now developed diarrhea, occurring 5-6 times per day.
The stools are described as watery and loose.
Patient denies seeing any blood in the stools and reports no abdominal pain.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No blood in stools. No abdo pain.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has reduced oral intake, is not drinking enough fluids, and feels dehydrated.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Reduced oral intake. Not drinking sufficient fluids. Feels dehydrated.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports no fever but feels warm and weak.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No fever/temp, but feels warm. Feels weak.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies any headaches or muscle pain.
Patient is unaware of any triggers and has had no contact with other unwell people.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Unaware of triggers. No unwell contacts

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has a history of asthma.

Medications.content: Patient uses a salbutamol inhaler as needed (PRN).

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.content: Patient has no known drug allergies.

Family_History.content: Patient's father had hypertension and died of bowel cancer.
Family_History.source_text: FH: father - HTN, died of bowel Ca.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient lives alone and works as a software engineer.
Patient is a non-smoker and drinks alcohol socially.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised supportive management including rest and increased fluid intake.
Recommended an over-the-counter oral rehydration solution (Dioralyte).

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to have a review in 7 days if not better.
Advised to seek review earlier for worsening symptoms such as diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, or reduced oral intake.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: or earlier if worsening sx (diarrhea, vomiting, abdo pain, reduced oral intake)
